note: DRAFT — v0.2.1 / B-004 Warrior skill questlines. Discoverable: Power Strike and Rage start on a level-up; Earthbreaker and Flame Cleave start when the rare drop is picked up or inspected. Completing a line unlocks that skill at rank 1; further ranks train at Calden. Soul Guard is parked (see Pitch Book). `desc` is player-facing; `notes` is design-only. Rewards are on the last step. `trigger` is level:N or item:<id>. Gates are checked when Calden would finish the line.  v0.2.3: A Crack in the Dirt and Hot Edge only unlock training; they do not grant rank 1. The Weight of a Swing and Blood Up still grant rank 1.  v0.2.4: The Dirt Path (ql_dirt_path), giver Pell, prereq sq_first_passive / first passive point. 4 Crows, reach the Banks, 5 Moles and 3 Ember Beetles, return to Pell. No skill grant.  v0.2.6: Ila kit = new Nature rank-1 recipe; quest gear gifts are exact; Hot Edge can start from Calden at level 6.  v0.2.7: ql_paths, Calden's short tutorial for Paths (talk, open the tree, train Power Strike rank 2, report back).  v0.2.8: ql_magic, Tamsin's Magician Path tutorial (talk, open the Magician tab, train Magic Bolt, report back).  v0.2.9: all lines rebuilt. Welcome to Meadow Town (intro chain), Path of the Warrior and Path of the Magician replace The Weight of a Swing, The Hero's Paths and The Quiet Spell. Lines appear gradually (see trigger). NPCs never hand over quest materials. Rewards cut to about a third. Titles, journal text and dialogue follow the tone guide in planning/v0.2.9.md.
